answer: Each identity stakes a 70-credit bond for a lotus-marked shore gauge at an ocean station and files a sonnet log of 14 timed wave counts. An auditor recomputes the expected count from the published wave-period table, compares it with the filed counts and mark log, and burns the bond and bars it on mismatch. First fee 33, kth 33+6(k-1), 1000th 6027; 1000 fakes pay 3,030,000 plus 70,000 locked. An honest agent files once, pays 33, recovers the 70 after a clean epoch. A rented-gauge ring fails: one serial binds to one key, reuse triggers a burn, and copied counts miss the window's period table.
